content: User sentiment: Teal = table view + pipeline overview, but overwhelming and AI skill suggestions frequently wrong; Huntr = best visual kanban, free tier capped at 40 jobs; Simplify = best for high-volume autofill, free. Rule of thumb: Teal if resume tailoring is the bottleneck, Huntr if visual board, Simplify if volume. Users abandon trackers that demand heavy manual data entry.
